name: Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6
summary: The step below the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 for late-2026 flagships, on the same 2 nm process with Oryon CPU cores reaching 5 GHz. Its core layout was not given in the launch reports; no test results yet.

default.note: From SoyaCincau's report of Qualcomm's announcement: shares the Extreme model's 2 nm process and 5 GHz CPU, LPDDR5X/LPDDR6 memory and UFS 5.0.
